title: Restore Text/PDF switching and balance the reader bottom panel
status: Approved and implemented; release validation in progress.
userRequest: Restore the Text/PDF view option at the bottom of the reader.
Make the lower panel visually even.
Restore a visible up-arrow to open reader controls.
Show images and a plan before implementation.
interpretation: The requested up-arrow means a visible expand control for the reader settings sheet; playback speed remains a separate control.
currentFindings: Original/text switching exists in the reader overflow menu.
The collapsed dock uses an unlabelled visual handle in a 48dp tap strip.
The current four-control row places Play/Pause off the horizontal center.

modeRow.location: Top row of the collapsed reader dock, replacing the existing handle strip
modeRow.article: Omit the selector for documents with no original page; keep the transport row.
modeRow.selectedState: Both labels remain visible; selected segment uses the current theme primary color with contrasting text.
modeRow.dimensions: Centered segment group approximately 192dp wide and at least 48dp tall; allow width/height growth for accessibility.

transportRow.layout: Five equal-width cells; Play/Pause at the exact horizontal center, paired controls symmetric.
transportRow.targetCollapsedDockHeight: About 112–124dp for PDF/image documents, excluding system insets and actual error/preparation rows.
transportRow.normalState: No additional explanatory text or decorative rows.

sheet.open: Tap the up-chevron or swipe up on the dock.
sheet.close: Tap the footer down-chevron, existing close button, swipe down, or Android Back.
sheet.footer: Use the same five-cell transport layout; the mode selector stays on the underlying reader.
sheet.speedAction: Reveal the existing Quick playback-speed section, or use an in-sheet picker; avoid stacking a second modal.
sheet.contents: Reuse existing Quick/Advanced settings, reading light, speech processing effort, text recognition and voice controls.
sheet.scrolling: Settings scroll above a fixed transport footer.

proposedDesign.themes: Use the same geometry across Warm Library, Modern Focus and Night Reader. Images show Warm Library; reader paper remains independent.
safetyAndState: View changes use the existing original/text state and preserve the document page, selection, narration position and failed-sentence marks.
Switching view or opening/closing the sheet must not start, pause, restart or regenerate speech by itself.
Do not rerun OCR merely to change view; retain existing loading/empty/error handling for unavailable extracted text.
Reset or finish page-turn animation safely before changing the displayed view.
Preserve current-page PDF zoom/pan and text scroll across toggles with bounded view state outside the removed content branch; keep auto-follow behavior.
Preserve preparation cancellation, selected-word playback, blocked-sentence skipping and notification gating in the shared transport.
Retain actionable progress and error controls only when their existing conditions apply.
Apply navigation/system insets once and preserve the existing hide-controls reader mode.

implementationSteps.change: Extract shared transport behavior and five-cell layout without changing playback actions.
Connect the dock segmented selector to existing reader view state and retain current-page viewport state across switches.
Reuse the balanced footer in reader controls, wire the down-chevron to dismissal, and route sheet speed changes within the sheet.
Check reader behavior and visual layout, then build only after design approval.

acceptanceChecks: PDF shows Text/PDF; images show Text/Image; articles show no misleading PDF option.
Play/Pause is centered and five controls have even spacing in collapsed and expanded states.
All three themes, 320dp-wide screen, large text, rotation and landscape retain usable touch targets.
TalkBack announces selected view, playback action, playback speed, and expand/collapse controls.
At large text sizes, a labelled speed icon may replace a clipped numeric rate while preserving the rate in accessibility semantics.
Tap and swipe open the sheet without conflicting with mode taps, page swipes or slider drags.
Mode switches preserve page/audio position and appropriate viewport state during paused and active narration.
Preparation cancel, selected-word start, failed-sentence next and errors remain functional.
Run the existing release checks; verify actual device layout when a device is available.

images.description: Collapsed dock in PDF and reflowed text views
Expanded reader controls and balanced footer

preview.note: Concept images use fictional sample content; they are not screenshots from an implemented build.
preview.implementationScope: The reader header and document rendering are context in the mockups; this change targets bottom controls and view-state continuity.

approval.request: This looks good to me. Implement it
